<!-- en -->
v0.1.5 is a feature release: the installer now manages shell completion, query tables gain a configurable column layout, daemon startup gets a skip gate for unchanged files, and two attribution issues are fixed.

### Highlights
- The installer sets up Tab completion for you: on zsh it interactively offers to enable the completion system and repair insecure directories, and after updating, a one-time migration notice points you at the installer command.
- Daemon restarts now skip unchanged session-log files, cutting startup catch-up on a large directory from seconds to milliseconds.

### New
- Installer-managed shell completion. install.sh audits the completion-directory chain — ownership, group/other writability, and macOS ACLs on every level from your home directory up to the filesystem root — and refuses to write when any level can be modified by others; when the completion system (`compinit`) is not enabled yet, it asks interactively (repair with `chmod go-w` plus standard `compinit`, `compinit -u`, or skip). fish gets a no-prompt setup with the same directory-chain checks, PowerShell asks and writes an atomic, idempotent marker block into `$PROFILE`, and bash gets a pointer to the bash-completion package. `INSTALL_COMPLETION=yes` runs the zsh path non-interactively for AI-agent one-line installs. The docs add the per-shell prerequisites and the three ways to handle `compinit` insecure directories.
- A successful `update` that first crosses v0.1.5 appends a one-time migration notice with the official installer command to the success output.
- `[query.output]` section: one global, ordered `columns` list controls which metric columns table-based query reports show — built-in grouped views, custom subqueries, groups, and `query session`. `query summary` does not use the layout and keeps its full summary. The default keeps today's seven columns; `cache_create` is optional and always stays in the `cache_hit` denominator. Editable in the TUI's Query page, with recovery actions for invalid layouts.

### Fixed
- Router attribution no longer goes missing when CC Switch logs land before the Claude message: client collection rounds now backfill attribution from already-staged `raw_router_logs` rows. Existing messages whose attribution is missing can be corrected with `token-usage collect router --client claude` only while their matching CC Switch logs are still readable; messages beyond the source retention window cannot be recovered.
- WorkBuddy vendor mapping from `models.json` now matches case-insensitively, so mixed-case entry ids meeting lower-cased log model ids no longer fall back to the client name.

### Improved
- Daemon startup catch-up now skips unchanged JSONL files (Claude and Codex) via a file-identity gate: file identity + mtime + size + parser version, committed in the same transaction as the messages. Any change, parse issue, or unreliable filesystem falls back to a full re-read. On a synthetic 399MB directory a gated restart takes ~3ms instead of ~7s; the first catch-up after upgrading re-scans once because the gate table is rebuilt.

### Installation
See the [README Quick Start](https://github.com/YuLaiZ/token-usage#quick-start). Existing users update in place with `token-usage update`.

<!-- zh -->
v0.1.5 是一个功能版本：安装脚本接管 Tab 补全自动配置，query 表格支持自定义指标列布局，daemon 启动新增未变化文件跳过门，并修复两处归因问题。

### 亮点
- 安装脚本现在会自动配置 Tab 补全：zsh 上交互询问是否启用补全系统并修复不安全目录；升级后成功输出附带一次性迁移提示，指向官方安装命令。
- daemon 重启跳过未变化的会话日志文件，大目录的启动 catch-up 从秒级降到毫秒级。

### 新增
- 安装脚本自动配置 Shell 补全。install.sh 写入前核验补全目录链的安全性——对主目录到文件系统根的每一层检查属主、组/其他用户可写性与 macOS ACL，任一层可被其他用户修改即拒绝写入；补全系统（`compinit`）尚未启用时交互询问（`chmod go-w` 修复并启用标准 `compinit`、`compinit -u` 或跳过）。fish 无询问自动写入（同款目录链安全检查）；PowerShell 询问后向 `$PROFILE` 写入原子、幂等的 marker 块；bash 给出 bash-completion 包指引。`INSTALL_COMPLETION=yes` 使 zsh 路径非交互执行（AI agent 一句话安装）。文档同步补齐各 shell 前置条件与 `compinit` 不安全目录的三种处理方式。
- `update` 成功升级首次跨过 v0.1.5 时，成功输出会追加一次性迁移提示并给出官方安装命令。
- 新增 `[query.output]` 配置段：一份全局、有序的 `columns` 指标列列表控制表格型 query 报表显示哪些列——内置分组视图、自定义子查询、组合查询与 `query session`。`query summary` 不使用该布局，保持完整摘要。默认保持现有七列；`cache_create` 可选显示且始终计入 `cache_hit` 分母。TUI 的 Query 页可编辑，布局非法时提供对应恢复动作。

### 修复
- 修复「CC Switch 日志先于 Claude 消息入库」交错时归因永久缺失的问题：client 采集轮入库后会对已入库的 `raw_router_logs` 行回填归因。存量缺失归因消息仅在源日志仍可读取时可用 `token-usage collect router --client claude` 修正；超出 CC Switch 日志保留期的消息无法恢复。
- 修复 WorkBuddy 的 `models.json` 供应商映射大小写匹配问题：混合大小写条目 id 遇到小写化的日志 model id 时不再回退显示客户端名。

### 优化
- daemon 启动 catch-up 通过文件身份门跳过未变化的 JSONL 文件（仅 Claude 与 Codex）：以文件身份 + mtime + 大小 + 解析器版本为证据，与消息同事务提交。任何变化、解析异常或不可靠文件系统都回退整文件重读。合成基准下 399MB 目录的命中轮重启约 3ms（原全量约 7s）；升级后首轮 catch-up 因门表重建会完整重扫一次，属预期行为。

### 安装
见 [README 快速开始](https://github.com/YuLaiZ/token-usage/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md#快速开始)。已有用户用 `token-usage update` 原地升级。
